mutants.note: The expiry comparison is strict, so a token remains usable at the exact expiresAt millisecond.
The role check accepts administrator when admin is required; a near-match role must still be denied.
The owner condition is dropped, allowing any authenticated user to read another user's document.
The dot-segment check is dropped; a path containing ../ can reach a file that should not be addressable.
The download name is not percent-decoded before validation, allowing encoded traversal text through the name check.
The absolute-name guard is dropped; an absolute filesystem name must be rejected by the name validator.
The title limit becomes exclusive, rejecting a title whose length is exactly the documented maximum.
Numeric bodies are accepted as if they were strings; input types must be enforced.
The export writes the title without HTML escaping, allowing markup in a title to become document markup.
A successful login no longer clears the failure state, so a later attempt remains locked.

refactors.note: same behaviour, new internals: field limits table, documents kept in a map
